query: web crawling pricing Hobbyist plan per URL re-sync

text: The web-crawling charge is $0.60. Web crawling costs $0.005 per URL, and every crawl run bills its URLs: the first crawl and each manual re-sync. That is 3 runs x 40 URLs = 120 URLs x $0.005 = $0.60. Manual re-sync is available on Hobbyist, and the charge is drawn from the $10/month included credits.
